description:
# Reference: DPC4-ChampSim/replacement/mockingjay, single-core build. Sizes are for
# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay
doc: >
  Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion, and a fill predicted to be reused after every line in
  the set is bypassed. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and
  train nothing.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay_conf
doc: >
  Mockingjay with a confidence mechanism for its reuse predictor. A 2-bit confidence
  counter is added to each predictor entry. Confidence increases on a sampled hit
  and decreases on a sampled miss or eviction. Bypasses are only performed for
  high-confidence predictions. This aims to reduce wrong bypasses.

    scope: per_line

    kind: counter

    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # Bypass only on high-confidence long-reuse predictions
    - confident_long_reuse: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73}
    - when:
        table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}
        table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: is_max, threshold: MAX}

    fold: [hit, prefetch]

tables:

    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating

    width: 2

    sets: {mirror: 32}

    ways: 5

      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}

        free: true

        free: true
    sweep:

new_words_text:
- name: train_rdp_hit
  place: step
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, age: state, scale: {int: [1,10]}, min_diff: {int: [0, 127]}}
  means: >
    Trains the rdp_table at the given index with the 'toward' op, using the provided age, scale, and min_diff.
    The rdp_table must be 'unset'. Then, increments the conf_table entry at the same index.

- name: train_rdp_miss
  place: step
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature}
  means: >
    Increments the rdp_table entry at the given index. The rdp_table must be 'unset', so an absent entry
    becomes rdp_table.max. Then, decrements the conf_table entry at the same index.

- name: confident_long_reuse
  place: condition
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, threshold: {int: [0, 127]}}
  means: >
    True if the rdp_table entry at index is present and its value is greater than the threshold,
    AND the conf_table entry at the same index is at its maximum value. False otherwise.
    The rdp_table must be 'unset'.

description:
# Based on Mockingjay, this design aims to isolate the benefit of a relative-only
# bypass condition while correcting for the regressions of its parent.
name: mj_revert_size_keep_rel_bypass
doc: >
  Reverts the predictor and sampler sizes to Mockingjay's configuration to fix
  the drop in prediction accuracy observed in the parent. Also restores
  Mockingjay's ETR assignment logic for long-reuse lines. Keeps the purely
  relative bypass condition, which was successful in reducing wrong bypasses.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after the victim
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11              # Reverted to Mockingjay's size

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048             # Reverted to Mockingjay's size
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # Reverted to Mockingjay's size
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO} # Reverted
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
# Reference: DPC4-ChampSim/replacement/mockingjay, single-core build. Sizes are for
# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay_min_diff_8
doc: >
  Improved RDP predictor agility by lowering the minimum difference threshold for 'toward'
  training from 16 to 8. This change aims to make the RDP values in the predictor table
  more responsive to actual reuse distances, thereby reducing `wrong_bypass` errors
  caused by over-estimated reuse distances, and potentially improving overall prediction accuracy.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8} # Changed from 16
        free: true
        stop: true

on_hit:

on_fill:

name: mj_confident_victim_bypass
doc: >
  Introduces a confidence mechanism to make bypass decisions more robust.
  Previous designs suffered from wrong bypasses. This design adds a confidence
  table, trained by the sampler, to track the reliability of reuse predictions.
  A new bypass condition, 'confident_pred_gt_victim_etr', only bypasses an
  incoming line if its predicted value is confidently worse than the victim line it
  would replace. This aims to reduce wrong bypasses without being overly conservative.

    width: 4

  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - confident_pred_gt_victim_etr: {pred_tbl: rdp, conf_tbl: conf_tbl, index: pc_sig, div: 8, conf_thresh: 2}

    width: 7

    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5                   # Reverted from 6 to stay within budget
    tag_bits: 10

      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 10, init: ZERO} # Matches pc_sig low_bits
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}

  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}

        except_touched: true

      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_fill:

description:
name: mj_confident_victim_bypass
doc: >
  Introduces a confidence-based bypass mechanism to address conflicting bypass errors.
  This design adds a 2-bit confidence table, trained by the sampler on reuse and
  eviction events. A new bypass condition, 'confident_pred_worse_than_victim',
  only permits a bypass if the prediction is confident (confidence >= 2) AND the
  incoming line's predicted value is worse than the victim's. This is paired with
  the static bypass for very long-lived lines, aiming to reduce both wrong_bypass
  and kept_dead mistakes by making more informed decisions.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - confident_pred_worse_than_victim: {rdp_tbl: rdp, conf_tbl: conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, conf_thresh: 2}
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: 1                   # confidence: 0..3

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - train: {table: conf, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}

on_fill:

new_words_text:
- name: confident_pred_worse_than_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    rdp_tbl: table
    conf_tbl: table
    index: signature
    div: {int: [1, 1024]}
    conf_thresh: {int: [0, 3]}
  means: >
    Calculates a predicted ETR for the incoming line as floor(rdp_tbl[index] / div).
    Reads the absolute value of the 'etr' field of the victim line ('victim_etr').
    Reads the confidence value from conf_tbl[index].
    The condition is true if the confidence is greater than or equal to conf_thresh AND
    the predicted ETR is strictly greater than victim_etr.
    If the rdp_tbl or conf_tbl entry is absent, the condition is false.
    The 'etr' field must be a per_line state field. This can only be used in 'bypass_when'.

doc: >
  Replaces the previous 'pred_exceeds_victim_with_margin' bypass condition with
  'pred_gt_relaxed_victim_etr'. The previous condition proved too strict, leading
  to increased 'evicted_sooner' and 'should_bypass' mistakes. This new condition
  allows for bypassing when the predicted ETR is greater than the victim's ETR
  minus a small margin (clamped at 0), making the bypass decision less strict.
  This aims to reduce the insertion of lines that are not reused (should_bypass)
  and prevent the eviction of lines that would be reused sooner (evicted_sooner),
  while retaining Mockingjay's original static bypass for very long reuse
  predictions.

If the confidence entry is absent, it is considered 0. The victim way has already been selected. The condition reads the absolute value of the 'etr' field of the victim way. The condition is true if the predicted ETR is strictly greater than the victim's absolute ETR AND the confidence value is greater than or equal to the conf_thresh. If the rdp_tbl entry is absent, the predicted ETR is 0, and the condition is false.
